title: User Activity for Past 30 Days
scenario: Find the number of daily active users for a period of 30 days ending 2019-07-27.
tableSchema: Activity (user_id INT, session_id INT, activity_date DATE, activity_type VARCHAR)
hint: Filter by date range and use COUNT(DISTINCT ...).
correctQuery: SELECT activity_date AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM Activity WHERE activity_date > '2019-06-27' AND activity_date <= '2019-07-27' GROUP BY activity_date;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE Activity (user_id INT, session_id INT, activity_date DATE, activity_type VARCHAR); INSERT INTO Activity VALUES (1, 1, '2019-07-20', 'open_session'), (1, 1, '2019-07-20', 'scroll_down'), (2, 4, '2019-07-20', 'open_session');
